about_the_game:
Breakout Epilepsia


⚠ Epilepsy Warning ⚠
The name Epilepsia is not random. This game contains fast flashing lights, intense patterns, and strong visual effects that may trigger seizures in people with photosensitivity or epilepsy. If you're prone to seizures or feel this game could affect you, we strongly advise against playing it. Play responsibly and prioritize your health.



Dive into a fast-paced retro arcade experience that blends classic Breakout gameplay with boss battles inspired by Space Invaders. Smash blocks, dodge incoming attacks, and take on fierce enemies that will test your skills and reflexes.

Follow the journey of Scarlet, a Russian-Mexican heroine on a mission to recover the three stolen crystals that have drained all color from Earth. To restore balance, she must defeat their guardians: Bella, an unpredictable gamer with borderline personality disorder; Kira, a tentacled alien inspired by Kraken legends; and Luna, a gothic girl who acquired dark powers during her time on Earth.

🎮 Features
✅ Striking black-and-white aesthetic with hypnotic effects.
✅ Fast-paced and challenging gameplay, perfect for short sessions.
✅ Three intense boss battles with unique mechanics.
✅ Classic Arkanoid/Breakout mechanics with a fresh twist.
✅ Space Invaders-style shooting sections during boss fights.



🎮 Developed by: Victoria “Cataxis” Pérez

🎵 Soundtrack by: LosthinK

🎨 Art by: Camila Deloris, Death Voice & Quetzalcoutl

🎤Voice Acting: Camila Deloris, Dafne “Blakes” Muñoz , Ilce S Perez C, Kar “Pinkchocoball” Chávez, Neko Chibioso & Yulisa Viridiana Meza Gonzáles

🛠 Testers: Evangelo Ruiz, Celeste “Levalotte” Uribe, JuanGdev, kaydev, Diego A. Gómez, Bryan Hernández Cabrera, Ilce S Pérez C, Lalo Rejón, Eduardo Emmanuel Barba Aldana, Eliana Ricci
